name: Moroccan Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 handful of fresh coriander, finely chopped

steps: Cut the tomatoes, pepper and onion into small dice.
Add the fresh coriander, cumin, salt, pepper, and vinegar.
Put it all into a container, put the lid on tightly, and give it a good shake to combine everything.
Let rest for 30 minutes to allow the flavours to mingle before serving.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
